title: The Law Of Attraction Book Podcast! Manifest Anything with Ho'oponopono  with @MiteshKhatriLOA
description:
Join Free Ho'oponopono Masterclass - http://miteshkhatri.com/zeeshan 

Manifest Anything with Ho'oponopono: Heal Your Mind, Change Your Life ! Law Of Attraction 
Book Podcast 

In Today’s Book Podcast, we have two amazing guests—Mitesh Khatri and Indu Khatri—who are experts in the Law of Attraction. They have helped thousands of people manifest their dreams and are the authors of the book The Law of Attraction. In this episode, they’ll reveal powerful technique Ho'oponopono to attract success, happiness, and abundance into your life

Find out more about Mitesh & Indu Khatri here:
